# Baltimore Ravens — 2026-07-26 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- Ravens placed six players on the PUP list as camp opens, headlined by two-time Pro Bowl DL Nnamdi Madubuike (neck) — cleared by independent spine and cervical doctors, he could return to practice as early as next week.
- Also on PUP: DL Travis Jones (pectoral), DT John Jenkins, ILB Teddye Buchanan (knee), OLB Adisa Isaac (elbow), and CB Bilhal Kone (knee); C Corey Bullock was placed on the non-football-illness (NFI) list.
- Ravens made room on the roster, signing veteran WR Chris Moore and OT Hakeem Adeniji while waiving P Luke Elzinga and G Jared Penning.
- Training camp opens Wednesday, July 29.

- 07/25: Ravens signed veteran WR Chris Moore and OT Hakeem Adeniji, waiving P Luke Elzinga and G Jared Penning to make room. [Zrebiec](https://x.com/jeffzrebiec/status/2081128121391042771) — also [Shaffer](https://x.com/jonas_shaffer/status/2081126559327436925)
